remarks: Welcome to this charming and bright oversized studio/1BD corner unit in the popular Hawthorne condo association in Greenwich. Perfect as a pied-a-terre or primary residence, this cozy home boasts an abundance of natural light, thanks to its desirable corner location and a warm, inviting atmosphere throughout. The open-concept living and dining area flow into a spacious kitchen. A French door leads to the garden patio, providing a peaceful outdoor retreat. The unit offers thoughtful built-ins and ample closet space throughout, ensuring plenty of storage, and the convenience of in-unit laundry adds to the appeal. Enjoy the convenience of living in a prime location with easy access to shopping, dining, and transportation, all within the vibrant Greenwich community of Glenville.
